svg.aria-label: Darhan Semiatov: Go backend · AI/LLM engineering

g.text: I build Go services that run in production and the ML/LLM pieces around them:
scoring models, LLM integrations, Telegram bots. 4th-year student at Narxoz
University, intern at QazCode. Open to Go / AI roles from 2027.
A map of places around Almaty for going out with friends, with real users. Go,
PostgreSQL, SSE chats, Telegram notifications, rate-limited auth, admin moderation.
Self-hosted: Docker and Caddy on an Oracle ARM VM, nightly backups.
A fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 regressor that scores essays on 4 criteria, exported to ONNX
and served by a Python service that a Go app calls. The LLM only explains the scores.
An ML study on historical Formula 1 data: preprocessing, XGBoost, a custom race-level
winner accuracy metric, feature importance and a temporal learning curve.
Captained a team at a hackathon with about 1,500 participants. In 2 days we built a
support copilot for a mobile operator: ticket category and priority classification,
answers grounded in the knowledge base.
Layered architecture (domain → application → adapters), tests on every layer, an
architecture.md in every repo, and CI before merge.
